top20Sample.product: TinySearch – token-efficient web research for local AI agents
top20Sample.reason: TinySearch把本地 agent 的网页研究成本压到 token 层面，值得看轻量检索能否成为端侧 agent 标配。

top20Sample.product: Agentic Orchestrator, a TUI for long-running coding agents
top20Sample.reason: Agentic Orchestrator把长时间编码 agent 做成 TUI 控制台，重点看它如何解决多任务等待、切换和中断恢复。

top20Sample.product: Ouijit, command terminals running coding agents
top20Sample.reason: Ouijit把命令终端改造成 coding agent 工作区，值得观察终端入口是否比 IDE 更适合持续代理任务。

top20Sample.product: StarSling
top20Sample.reason: StarSling把 CI 加速和 AI 自优化绑定，适合看基础设施产品如何用成本节省包装成明确采购理由。

top20Sample.product: Framein – a local work-state layer that keeps AI agents in context
top20Sample.reason: Framein主打本地工作状态层，关键价值在于减少 agent 反复读上下文和跨工具失忆。

top20Sample.product: Bulwark – a kernel read gate so coding agents can't read .env or .ssh
top20Sample.reason: Bulwark从内核读权限切入 agent 安全，值得看它能否把 .env、.ssh 风险做成开发者默认防线。

top20Sample.product: Capacitor – shared mem for Claude Code, Cursor and other coding agents
top20Sample.reason: Capacitor想在 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具间共享记忆，核心看跨 IDE 上下文是否真能减少重复提示。

top20Sample.product: Naja-scope – Let AI agents explore SystemVerilog netlists over MCP
top20Sample.reason: Naja-scope把 MCP 接到 SystemVerilog 网表探索，说明 agent 工具链正在进入很窄但高价值的工程场景。

top20Sample.product: SlimSnap – mark a screenshot element, get JSON for your coding agent
top20Sample.reason: SlimSnap把截图元素转成 agent 可用 JSON，适合观察视觉标注如何降低前端修改的沟通成本。

top20Sample.product: DriftGuard – response drift detection for LangGraph agents
top20Sample.reason: DriftGuard聚焦 LangGraph agent 响应漂移，价值在于把不可控输出变成可监测的工程质量问题。

top20Sample.product: Busabase – an approval-first database and knowledge base for AI agents
top20Sample.reason: Busabase强调 approval-first 数据库与知识库，值得看 human-in-the-loop 是否能成为 agent 存储层卖点。

top20Sample.product: Scaffold a BigQuery and dbt and Cube project an AI agent can operate
top20Sample.reason: Revos 这类脚手架把数据栈预设成 agent 可操作结构，启发在于先改工程形态再谈自动化能力。

top20Sample.product: Kinetk – Watch agent build a launch and growth plan for your product
top20Sample.reason: Kinetk让 agent 生成 launch 与增长方案，重点不是计划文本，而是能否接入真实实验和反馈闭环。

top20Sample.product: NodePad – AI agent on a canvas instead of a linear chat
top20Sample.reason: NodePad把 agent 从线性聊天搬到画布，值得看空间化界面是否更适合拆解、并行和回看复杂任务。

top20Sample.product: Let your AI agent manage your link in bio
top20Sample.reason: Keepp Skill把 link-in-bio 管理交给 agent，场景偏窄，适合弱观察技能形态如何进入个人主页运营。

top20Sample.product: Crosswalk mapping AI-agent design controls to NIST, ISO 42001, OWASP
top20Sample.reason: AgentAZ Crosswalk把设计控制映射到合规框架，价值在于把 agent 风险治理做成可交付清单。

top20Sample.product: I Made an SDK to work with Vapi and Retell without vendor lock in
top20Sample.reason: voice-ai.dev针对 Vapi 和 Retell 做无锁定 SDK，值得看语音 agent 生态是否出现中立集成层。

top20Sample.product: Myna – a local AI Chief of Staff that remembers your work
top20Sample.reason: Myna把本地记忆包装成 AI Chief of Staff，关键看它是否能沉淀工作上下文而不是又一个聊天壳。

top20Sample.product: ForthWrite – Email AI that learns your voice from every edit you send
top20Sample.reason: ForthWrite从每次邮件编辑里学习语气，适合观察“用户修正”能否变成个人 AI 写作的长期数据资产。

top20Sample.product: FastReact – FastAPI and React Starter Kit for AI SaaS
top20Sample.reason: FastReact定位 AI SaaS starter kit，价值有限但可看开发者是否需要专门面向 AI 产品的默认模板。
